Varun came to me convinced he "always blanks in vivas". He has one in two weeks and was talking about skipping it.

I asked him to test the rule. We listed every viva since first year: seven in total. He blanked in two. In five he answered most questions, including one where the examiner praised his circuit explanation.

Kashish
